why: A payload in a commit behind every branch tip, or in an object nothing reaches, is not put back by a checkout of any branch, and reading all of history costs far more than reading the tips. By default only what a checkout, reset, restore or stash pop can bring back is read, so this repository is clean, exit 0, and the ok line says what was read. git-earlier-commits-are-read-with-git-all pins the other half (ADR-0068).

must_print: 1 git repository read (last commits, staged files, 1 branch or tag, 0 stashes), none holds the payload
